summary: First run: comprehensive backend API testing (23/23 pytest passed) + frontend E2E flows for citizen (Hindi AI analyze, duplicate warning, submit) and admin (manage modal, proof-photo update). Emergent LLM Hindi→English translation confirmed live. Role-based access control verified (citizen=403 on admin endpoints, citizen=403 on complaint status update). Proof-of-work photo end-to-end verified via API + UI DOM inspection.

minor.issue: Missing admin/dev auth dependency — endpoint is publicly accessible. Every other /api/admin/* route uses require_admin_or_dev; this one has no guard. Not exploitable (data is non-sensitive ward metadata) but inconsistent with RBAC contract.

ai_service.py uses model name 'gpt-5.4-mini' via emergentintegrations. Live call succeeds and returns Hindi detection + English translation, but this is a non-standard model tag — verify with Emergent LLM provider that this is intended vs. e.g. gpt-4o-mini/gpt-5-mini.
Uses max(actual, seed_floor) — real counts are masked under floor values (1248/326/214/708). Intentional for demo look-and-feel but hides true DB state; call out in docs.

issues: Status filter select at top of queue and modal status select share generic <select> tags with no unique data-testid — makes automated targeting fragile. Recommend adding data-testid='queue-status-filter' and data-testid='modal-status-select' for reliable E2E testing.

action_items: Add require_admin_or_dev dependency to GET /api/admin/wards for consistency.
Add unique data-testid to (a) queue status filter select and (b) modal status select in AdminDashboard.jsx for reliable automation.
Verify 'gpt-5.4-mini' is the intended Emergent LLM model tag (works today, but tag is unusual).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — /api/admin/wards is the ONLY admin route without the require_admin_or_dev guard (line 587-592).
server.py — /api/public/stats and /api/admin/analytics use max(actual, seed_floor) pattern which permanently masks real values; consider gating with a DEMO_MODE env flag.

AdminDashboard.jsx — the queue status filter select and modal status select both render as bare <select> without data-testid, causing E2E scripts using generic selectors to accidentally hit the queue filter (led to a flaky UI test in this run; not a product bug).
AdminDashboard.jsx — proof photo is stored as base64 data URL (documented as intentional for demo). Recommend future migration to object storage for scalability.

seed_data floor values (1248/326/214/708) match resolution_rate '56.7%' hardcoded string in admin analytics — inconsistency (708/1248 = 56.7% is coincidentally right, but if seed changes the string won't).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all functional flows verified; one UI selector flakiness handled)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Live Emergent LLM verified for Hindi input — returns detected_language=Hindi and English translated_text. Admin proof-photo flow verified at API layer (proof_photo_url appended to status_history and set as resolution_photo_url on complaint doc). The UI modal correctly enforces proof photo requirement in code (AdminDashboard.jsx:125). Playwright note: the quick-fill-{role}-btn button ALSO submits the login (via fillAndLoginDemo) — do NOT click login-submit-btn after it. Also there are multiple <select> elements on admin page (queue filter + modal status); use scoped selectors when targeting the modal status.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product blocking issues found. Only one minor RBAC inconsistency on /api/admin/wards and a testability suggestion for admin modal selects.
